Excel provides an overview of the features used to create a worksheet in Microsoft Excel. Tour the Excel screen, enter, copy and move data, and format cells. Explore other features, including conditional formatting, sorting data, customizing settings, and viewing, saving, and printing a worksheet.
Excel Formulas teaches how to use Formulas in Excel, including SUM, AVERAGE, XLOOKUP, MATCH, and INDEX among others, as well as best practices for applying them to your spreadsheets.

The Legislative Draft Request (LDR) system is an internal website that allows members and committees to request legislative drafts, access information about draft requests made by their office, and view completed draft text. Learn how to review information on the home page, create a new request, view office drafts reports, and manage office security. (1 hr.)

LMS (Legislative Management System) allows legislative analysts to track the movement of bills and store comments and bill information. In this class, create bill tracks, bill lists, and searches, customize folders, perform mass updates, and generate custom reports with recommendations, comments, and statistical data. (2 hrs.)

Outlook covers many basic features and functions of Microsoft Outlook, including customizing email and calendar features, using the address book, and accessing your email using Outlook Web App. Perform a variety of actions such as sending an email, creating a contact, and sharing your calendar.
Learn about Microsoft Teams channels, make calls, organize meetings, work with team files, and collaborate on shared files.

Attendees will gain a foundational understanding of the Texas Legislative Information Systems (TLIS), Legislative Management System (LMS), Correspondence Management System (CMS), Legislative Draft Request (LDR), CapCentral, and Office 365 applications. The session will also cover the technical environment in which these tools operate, including system access, navigation, and basic troubleshooting tips.

TLIS introduces you to the features of the Texas Legislative Information System. Discover the different ways to access and search for bill information using the Bill Lookup, Bill Search, Text Search, Drilldown Bill Search, and Witness List Search features. Find how to view reports, calendar and agenda items, committee meetings and minutes, and use the My TLIS features to create watch lists and set bill alerts to track the actions on bills. (2 hr.)

Word introduces you to features in Microsoft Word used to create, format, edit, and print documents. The class provides hands-on practice formatting letters and documents. Set up paragraphs, set margins, tabs, and fonts, insert charts, tables, images, and symbols, and check spelling and grammar.

Prepare your Word documents for accessible PDF export. This class covers the best practices for structuring and formatting your Word documents to ensure they are accessible from the start, saving you time and effort.
This hands-on workshop will teach you how to make your PDF documents fully accessible using Adobe Acrobat. You’ll learn the essential techniques to ensure your documents are readable by everyone.
